description: This Java source file defines the AlarmActivity class for an Android app. The activity manages UI buttons to start and stop a repeating alarm service using AlarmManager and PendingIntent; it sets up callbacks for user interactions and initializes system services.

classes.name: AlarmActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing alarm start/stop controls and scheduling repeating alarms with AlarmManager.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components and system services.

methods.name: mStartAlarmListener (OnClickListener)
methods.description: Handles the start button click, sets up a repeating alarm with AlarmManager.

methods.name: mStopAlarmListener (OnClickListener)
methods.description: Handles the stop button click, cancels the scheduled alarm.
